dict.string: Gary 2.0 - Write/backfill game_recaps (the Home marquee headline TEXT) for TODAY + YESTERDAY (ET), idempotent; $0 when nothing new. scripts/run-game-recaps.js now defaults to estDate(0)+estDate(-1) like the cloud grader, so today's finished games get recapped same-day and the headline rolls (the cloud grader settles game_results as games finish, but recap TEXT is written only here). Two morning passes (8:30/10:30) catch the June-24-style overnight gap; two afternoon/evening passes (17:00/20:15 local) fire just after the daily-results grader's 16:45/20:00 runs settle today's slate so today's recaps land before the 2am yesterday pass. Steps inlined because launchd's bash is TCC-blocked from READING scripts in ~/Desktop but can cd there and exec node.

array.string: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="/Users/adam.preda/.local/share/gary/runtimes/node-v22.23.2-darwin-arm64/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd /Users/adam.preda/Desktop/Gary2.0/gary2.0 || exit $?; gary_try=0; while :; do gary_try=$((gary_try+1)); gary_t0=$(date +%s); node scripts/run-game-recaps.js; gary_rc=$?; gary_dt=$(( $(date +%s) - gary_t0 )); if [ "$gary_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$gary_dt" -le 15 ] && [ "$gary_try" -lt 3 ]; then echo "scripts/run-game-recaps.js died within ${gary_dt}s (rc=$gary_rc) — startup retry $gary_try/2 after 5s (Sep 2 2026: launchd node EINTR uv_cwd)" >&2; sleep 5; continue; fi; break; done; exit "$gary_rc"
